data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order: open the form (with the optional pay-with-miles toggle), type the origin and destination and pick each suggestion, set dates, travelers and cabin, click Find flights, then pick a fare. It is concrete enough to automate, but trip type is only implied ('if roundtrip') rather than named as a parameter, and the fare-selection step is loosely defined.
